{"reason":"Replace the medium-or-higher branch’s supplier action with alert-planner/immediate-expedite-review. It costs 35,000 instead of 45,000 and always arrives in time, saving 340,000 across 34 switches and preventing stockouts seen in the medium/5.3 and medium/2.8 rows.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
